scripts.dev: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:holder:release && pnpm --parallel --filter @bazhen/daemon --filter @bazhen/web run dev < /dev/null
scripts.bazhen: pnpm -s run build:cli && pnpm -s run build:holder:release && target/release/bazhen
scripts.build: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:holder:release && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @bazhen/web run build
scripts.test:holder: pnpm run build:holder && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 4G --time 20m -- vitest run --project holder
scripts.test:containment: pnpm run build:holder && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 4G --time 20m -- vitest run --project containment
scripts.test:api: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:holder:release && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 4G --time 30m -- vitest run --project api
scripts.check: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/check-standards.ts && node scripts/protocol-schema.ts --check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run deny && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:medium && pnpm run test:bench
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:holder:release && pnpm --filter @bazhen/e2e-tests run test
scripts.test:medium: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:engine && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 8G --time 20m -- vitest run --project medium --project cli
scripts.test:soak: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:holder:release && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 8G --time 60m -- vitest run --project soak
scripts.soak: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:holder:release && node scripts/soak.ts
scripts.bench:engine: pnpm run build:engine && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 4G --time 10m -- node scripts/engine-replay.ts
scripts.test:bench: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm run build:cli && node scripts/capped.ts --memory 4G --time 10m -- vitest run --project bench
